tasks.subject: Fix bobmani/bobmania repository structure by removing itgmania submodule
tasks.description:
1. Identify how `itgmania` was incorrectly added as a submodule to `bobmani/bobmania`.
2. Remove the `itgmania` submodule from `bobmani/bobmania`.
3. Ensure `itgmania` and `bobmania` exist as siblings or separate repositories in the workspace as intended.
4. Clean up the `.gitmodules` and `.git/config` in `bobmani/bobmania`.
5. Verify that both projects can be built or synced independently.

tasks.subject: Repair bobfilez submodule links (VERT)
